templates_by_plan.Sweetheart, P350 a month, 40 photos, or: all, including Christening (storybook), Baby Shower (gift), Gender Reveal (scratch), Class Reunion (memory), Graduation Party (stars)

do_not_claim: RSVP, guest list, reply counts or reminders: the templates only ask guests to reply by message ('Kindly let us know by [RSVP date]'); nothing in the app collects replies
'Costs less' or any saving in pesos: no comparison with printing has been measured; say 'no printing' instead
An address of your own (love-name.domain) for invitations: the subdomains feature flag is off
Anything about guests not needing an app or a sign-up beyond 'opens in the browser': true by design (public /p/{slug}) but untested on old phones
Seasonal party templates (Halloween, Christmas, Valentine) outside their windows: Christmas Party opens 11 Dec
product_observations: On invitation pages the heading and closing line still read 'A letter for <name>' and 'The envelope is open: a letter for <name>' (seen in the Wedding Invitation and Debut stills). Fix before paid ads, or make the cards avoid showing those lines.
The page is addressed to a recipient name, so for an invitation the host names the page after the guests ('Our family and friends') and writes the host's own names in the text.
